scope: The package gate from a fresh clone of this repository's committed HEAD, including the Hex archive and out-of-tree compilation gate, on both required Elixir/OTP runtimes; the minimum lane runs the tools that tooling/packages.yaml keeps on it

source_identity.kind: git clone --no-local of the repository's committed HEAD inside the container; no working-tree copy

environment.dockerfile: test/software/Dockerfile.linux; the current lane adds clang-format-23 and clang-tidy-23 23.1.2 from apt.llvm.org for the native tools
environment.platform: Linux arm64 (container VM on macOS arm64)
environment.container: docker run --rm --init --cpus 4 --memory 6g with a read-only repository mount, both lanes concurrently; the gate runs as unprivileged uid 1000 so permission-denial tests observe ordinary filesystem semantics
commands: mix deps.get (repository root, for the native tools the package gate runs there)
WOTEX_PATH_DEPS=1 mix check --no-retry, with --except for formatter, credo, doctor, dialyzer, ex_doc, mix_audit, hex_audit, diff, native_format, native_lint and native_test on the minimum lane

assertions: Both runtimes pass the package gate from a clone of the committed repository as an unprivileged user, and the clone has no changes afterwards
Both runtimes build the byte-identical Hex archive 1d3d3c37677a4539c50f4511fb8edbfc10c505a42d269b062c529c204578694f and compile it out of tree
The current lane also passes Credo, Doctor, Dialyzer, ExDoc, the dependency audits, clang-format on changed lines, clang-tidy and the twelve native fault and vector executables
unaccepted: Static analysis and the native tools on the minimum runtime, which CI does not run there
Linux x86_64, other distributions and other toolchains
